boss.scope: 공식 문서에 있는 Python BOSS, 과거 Tetrad Final 재현 아님. Uniform에서는 Gaussian BIC의 quasi-score 가정 차이 명시

scm.selection: 각 family 공통 alpha: 별도 validation seed의 전체 노드 표준화 MSE를 graph 등가 평균해 최소 선택, 정확동률 더 강한 규제. Gaussian은 PC/BOSS만 선택에 사용하고 진단 Direct에도 같은 alpha 적용
scm.no_confirmed_path_policy: 기준 A=0을 사전 fallback으로 실행하고 NO_CONFIRMED_PATH_BASELINE_FALLBACK 기록. 정보 있는 추천과 구분

policy.mec_limit_policy: if cap exceeded, block auxiliary policies, do not truncate or select DAGs with truth
policy.fitting: common alpha per observed dataset; extension models same alpha/data
policy.point_prediction: unweighted mean over extension models; not posterior probability
policy.no_path_rule: fallback baseline distinguished from computed baseline; relationship with path metric is mechanical and not a new causal effect

acceptance.failure: stop before learning if any structure fails; no silent redesign

evaluation.condition_index: 0..8 union grid,9 independent reference; map each scenario grid by value
evaluation.seed_formula: structure evaluation base + action_index*1000 + condition_index*10 + batch
evaluation.fraction_reference_gap_lost: regret/(reference_loss-best_loss) only if gap>=floor, else null/UNSTABLE_REFERENCE_GAP

metrics.key_paths: all simple directed reference paths, union-edge recall and complete-path fraction

analysis.active: confirmation_analysis replaces previous exploratory LOSO protocol

controlled_errors.scope: separate artificial errors; lexical rules fixed before confirmation, NOT real discovery

families.C: chain+skip probability .32, negative direct shortcut and signed extra edges

generation_rules.coefficients: uniform magnitude .35..1.2 rounded4; positive chains; family C direct shortcut negative and extra edges randomly signed
generation_rules.reject: same node count and isomorphic after removing at most1edge from each (old or already accepted); B requires multiple paths; no quality/outcome input
generation_rules.task_rule: last core edge direct and first core->last core path, fixed goals .65/.6 independent of coefficients

execution.worker: unchanged scripts/learn_diverse_graph.py, independent child per graph
execution.parallelism: 3 child processes per dataset, isolated RNG, fixed result collection order

confirmation_analysis.uncertainty_limit: fixed4-per-family quotas and uniqueness rejection constrain exchangeability; structure bootstrap is conditional descriptive precision, not random manufacturing-population sampling or uncertainty in old fitted models

decision.invalid: not all12 structures evaluated; any structure has fewer than4datasets with at least2algorithms; pooled skeleton or path metric constant

confirmation_analysis.all_sensitivity_settings: primary5/.2, fine9/.2, low5/.1, high5/.4 all12 structures/both tasks/3policies; assess separately
confirmation_analysis.fixed_effect: all graphs predict do(.5)-do(0) without optimizing, compare empirical independent do means and analytic mean
confirmation_analysis.inference_limit: rule-generated synthetic families; old metric candidates already selected after exploratory findings; no causal effect of metric, no manufacturing claim
